slots.title: UK crypto trader says almost $800,000 lost in knife attack as wrench attacks proliferate
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: A crypto trader in the U.K. claimed masked intruders stole nearly $800,000 in cryptocurrency at knifepoint, furthering concerns of "wrench attacks" spreading in the country.

slots.title: South Korea blocks 27 crypto exchanges, including Bitmart and Kucoin
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The country’s regulators are stepping up their earlier restrictions on mobile apps to websites, targeting unregistered exchanges before investors report losses.

slots.title: Satlyt, founded by a former Google and SpaceX product manager, raises $8M to run AI on satellites
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: Satlyt wants to be the Android of orbital computing, offering open software that works on many companies' satellites, versus SpaceX's closed, all-in-one iPhone-style approach.

slots.title: The 2026 Startup Battlefield Top 20: From organs to orbit and everything in between
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: Twenty founders just earned their shot at Disrupt glory. They're headed to the main stage at TechCrunch Disrupt to compete for the $100,000 prize and the coveted Disrupt Cup.

slots.title: Crypto exchange MNX takes on OKX, BitGet offering pre-IPO futures for AI giants
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: MNX is offering a different way to trade the future valuations of private AI companies, including OpenAI, Anthropic and DeepSeek.
slots.reason: A major development affecting both AI and blockchain

slots.title: Federated Hermes joins Wall Street's tokenization push with plans for first onchain fund shares
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The $911 billion Pittsburgh-based asset manager is teaming up with Prometheum to bring blockchain-based share classes of its funds to traditional brokerage accounts.
slots.reason: Outside your usual reads — worth a skim
